text_markup: The Corp, playing as {card:Argus Security: Protection Guaranteed}, has scored {card:The Cleaners}. The Runner makes a run on R&D and steals {card:Hostile Takeover}. Argus Security's ability triggers and the Runner chooses to suffer 2 meat damage. As {card:The Cleaners} only adds additional damage to damage done by the Corp, its ability does not apply. When the Corp plays {card:Punitive Counterstrike} on their next turn, {card:The Cleaners} does increase the amount of damage done by {card:Punitive Counterstrike}.
